## 2026-11-15：S2浏览器反馈分流与离线修复预览 v1

本步把源oracle、目标运行、视觉观察、评估证据／捕获阻断分成机器通道，验证与既有RepairPromptBuilder的离线接口；**不是自动repair已经接入生产，也不是复杂组件修好了**。报告技能用于区分观察、复核、候选与放行；旧133单元／元数据保留。未改旧visual_eval、Prompt文件、RepairStage、调度器／候选门或组件。

- 核验旧130payload后，回放5类记录。corrected_run／repeat各4项visual_match_only，Analytics review_source_oracle；10条源诊断未误作San错误，7项矩形和1326／1625高度差保留。真实目标修复预览0、模型0；不将静态视觉一致当组件综合通过或新迁移率。
- 初始run因缺完整重复观察进入证据复核；滚动条反事实的styles／extent变化进入评估复核，不根据报错文字改业务方法。HTML高度差控制没有源Vue／目标San代码绑定，不能冒充组件修复输入。
- 外部固定封存指纹及路径／HTML／PNG CRC／哈希／重复观察／指标分母等一致性检查，关键矩形／样式差异重新计算；不信调用方passed／eligible／clean／stable／路由标志。来源从唯一合法loopback页栈帧保守归属，不按“Vue／San”文字猜；旧v2仍缺原生page/session登记和实际端口身份核验，不宣称生产级归属证明。
- 只对源正常、证据完整、绑定当前代码与props的目标问题生成离线Prompt预览；每次重读固定证据，保留原validation错误及已认可旧目标visual诊断，不改state或清语义阻断。源／未知旧visual诊断要求复核，不静默删除／转发。合成正向夹具实际调用既有PromptBuilder并保留source_dynamic_assignment_unproven，禁止网络；这不是组件修复或模型有效性证据。所有repair_dispatch_allowed恒false。
- 新50+旧适配39+repair Prompt／循环34+动态键保护12，共135项分别通过，非全仓库或旧273项campaign。合成PNG／JSON只作单元夹具；旧repair测试用stub，无新模型／浏览器／服务器／人工确认。65个既有相关文件、3个人工配置、6个冻结输入、旧分数不改，未安装依赖／commit／push。

证据：`data/experiments/analysis/browser_feedback_routing_v1_20261115/REPORT.md`；接口说明：`docs/ir-design/browser-feedback-routing-v1.md`。PNG仅核验块／CRC及头部，**不独立解码或重算像素／SSIM**；封存哈希证明与外部固定证据一致，不认证未知生产者。完整SSM绑定、状态空间／交互、永久稳定、跨机器字体与逐页存储隔离等未完成，用户保留的任意键及通知／异常风险仍不解除。

下一项先补原生page/session登记和逐页持久化隔离，再明确错误级别／场景／阈值、冻结生产协议后接入批处理；源oracle警告不能擅自吞掉或自动改源。不新增互操作／provider或业务调用方协议，不直接付费全30或独立测试。下格只读核查，不跑浏览器／模型；未打开Notebook UI。

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re
root = next(p for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (p / 'migration_pipeline').is_dir() and (p / 'notebooks').is_dir())
base = root / 'data/experiments/analysis/browser_feedback_routing_v1_20261115'
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for line in (base / 'SHA256SUMS.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
    expected, relative = line.split('  ', 1)
    path = (base / relative).resolve()
    assert path.is_relative_to(base.resolve()) and sha(path) == expected, relative
baseline = read(base / 'baseline.json')
assert len(baseline['protected']) == 65 and len(baseline['manual']) == 3
for path, expected in {**baseline['protected'], **baseline['manual']}.items():
    assert sha(root / path) == expected, path
for item in baseline['selection']:
    for field in ['source','target']:
        assert sha(root / item[field]['path']) == item[field]['sha256']
prior_seal = root / baseline['prior_seal']['path']
assert sha(prior_seal) == baseline['prior_seal']['sha256']
assert len(prior_seal.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()) == 130
for line in prior_seal.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
    expected, relative = line.split('  ', 1)
    assert sha(prior_seal.parent / relative) == expected
matrix = read(base / 'action_matrix.json')
assert matrix['corrected_run'] == matrix['repeat'] == ['visual_match_only']*4 + ['review_source_oracle']
assert matrix['run'] == ['review_evaluator_or_evidence']*5
assert matrix['gutter_counterfactual'] == ['review_evaluator_or_evidence']
for folder in ['replay','verified_replay']:
    summary = read(base / folder / 'summary.json')
    assert summary['model_calls'] == 0 and not summary['browser_started']
    assert summary['target_repair_previews_for_real_scenes'] == 0 and not summary['auto_dispatch_allowed']
    for name in ['corrected_run','repeat','run','gutter_counterfactual','controls']:
        packet = read(base / folder / (name+'.json'))
        assert packet['evidence']['seal_sha256'] == baseline['prior_seal']['sha256']
        assert not packet['repair_dispatch_allowed'] and not packet['production_protocol_frozen']
        assert not packet['semantic_gate_bypass_allowed'] and packet['model_calls'] == 0
        assert [s['recommended_action'] for s in packet['scenes']] == matrix[name]
        assert all(not s['repair_dispatch_allowed'] and not s['migration_pass_certified'] for s in packet['scenes'])
    final = read(base / folder / 'corrected_run.json')
    assert all(not s['target_feedback_eligible'] for s in final['scenes'])
    scene = final['scenes'][-1]
    assert len([i for i in scene['issues'] if i['channel'] == 'source_oracle']) == 10
    assert not any(i['channel'] == 'target_runtime' for i in scene['issues'])
    assert len(scene['observation']['style_changes']) == 7 and scene['observation']['metrics'] is None
    assert scene['observation']['dimensions'] == {'source':[1280,1326],'target':[1280,1625]}
    control = read(base / folder / 'controls.json')['scenes'][3]
    assert control['recommended_action'] == 'review_target_candidate' and not control['target_feedback_eligible']
tests = read(base / 'tests.json')
assert tests['tests_run'] == 135 and tests['exit_code'] == 0 and not tests['prior_273_rerun']
assert sorted(r['tests_run'] for r in tests['rows']) == [12,34,39,50]
assert all(r['exit_code'] == 0 and re.search(r'\nOK\s*$',r['output']) for r in tests['rows'])
for row in tests['rows']:
    assert int(re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests',row['output'])[1]) == row['tests_run']
implementation = read(base / 'implementation.json')
assert len(implementation['files']) == 4 and not implementation['production_rules_prompt_or_scheduler_changed']
for path, item in implementation['files'].items():
    assert sha(root / path) == item['sha256'] and (root / path).read_text(encoding='utf-8') == item['frozen_source']
audit = read(base / 'audit.json')
assert audit['dynamic_public_key_block_retained'] and not audit['notification_or_exception_boundary_resolved']
assert audit['actual_target_repair_previews'] == 0 and not audit['production_auto_dispatch_enabled']
assert not audit['production_rules_scheduler_or_prompt_changed'] and not audit['pixel_ssim_independently_recomputed']
assert audit['new_model_calls'] == 0 and audit['new_browser_runs'] == 0
assert audit['original_batch'] == {'configured':30,'passed':24,'failed':6,'execution_errors':0,'total_tokens':1821544}
nb = read(root / baseline['notebook']['path'])
stable = lambda v: hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
assert stable(nb['cells'][:133]) == baseline['notebook']['cells_sha256']
assert stable(nb['metadata']) == baseline['notebook']['metadata_sha256']
print({'new_tests':50,'targeted_tests':135,'real_scenes':['visual_match_only']*4+['review_source_oracle'],'actual_target_previews':0,'auto_dispatch':False,'model_calls':0,'batch':'unchanged 24/30'})
